```{r include=FALSE, results='hide'}
#Install required packages

if(!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

install.packages(c(
  "pheatmap",
  "ggplot2",
  "EnhancedVolcano",
  "RColorBrewer"
))

```

```{r include=FALSE}
# loading necessary libraries

library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r}
#Load count matrix and metadata
counts <- read.csv(("data/miRNA_countmatrix.csv"),
                    row.names = 1)

meta <- read.csv(("data/sample_info.csv"),
                 row.names = 1)

head(counts)
head(meta)

```


```{r}
#aligning order of metadata according to countmatrix

meta <- meta[colnames(counts), ]


# sanity check

all(rownames(meta) == colnames(counts))
```
```{r}
# Number of miRNAs
nrow(counts)

#number of samples
ncol(counts)

```

```{r}
# creating  Deseq2 Dataset

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = meta,
  design = ~dataset + condition
)

dds

```

```{r}
#filtering low quality counts mirna

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3

dds <- dds[keep, ]

dim(dds)
```

```{r}
#converting metadata to factors

dds$condition <- factor(dds$condition)
dds$dataset <- factor(dds$dataset)


dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "Healthy Control")
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```


```{r}
res <- results(dds, alpha = 0.1)

summary(res)

```
```{r}
library(limma)

vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)


assay(vsd) <- removeBatchEffect(
  assay(vsd),
  batch = vsd$dataset
  )

pca_data <- plotPCA(
  vsd,
  intgroup = "condition",
  returnData = TRUE
  )

percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  labs( x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
        y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")
        ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(res)

hist(df$pvalue,
     breaks = 50,
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "black",
     main = "Distribution plot",
     xlab = "p-value")
```

```{r}

# Sort all mirnas by p-value less than 0.05 and log2fc >=0.5, with most significant at top

sig <- subset(res, pvalue < 0.05 &
                abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5)

sig <- sig[order(sig$pvalue),]

#Quick sanity check
nrow(sig)
head(sig)
```

```{r}

# save the significant mirnas in csv file 

write.csv(as.data.frame(sig),
          "results/p_value_Significant_miRNAS.csv")
```

```{r}
#High_confidence p adj values, with most significant at top

high_conf <- subset(res, padj < 0.1 & 
                      abs(res$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5)

high_conf <- high_conf[order(high_conf$padj), ]


nrow(high_conf)
head(high_conf)
 
 
write.csv(as.data.frame(high_conf),
           "results/padj0.1_Significant_miRNAS.csv")
```

```{r}
# MA plot, it shows mean expression vs fold change, for finding bias and spread

df <- as.data.frame(res)

df$sig <- df$pvalue < 0.05 & 
  abs(df$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5

ggplot(df, aes(baseMean, log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("grey", "red"),
    labels = c("Healthy Control", "SCZ")) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  labs(title = "MA Plot",
       x = "Mean Expression",
       y = "Log2 Fold Change",
       color = "p-value < 0.05") +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("plots/MA_plot.png", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 500)
```

```{r}

#volcano_plot

df <- as.data.frame(res)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue))) +

  geom_point(aes(color = pvalue < 0.05),
                 size = 2.5, alpha= 1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "red")) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +

  labs(
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-log10(p-value)",
       ) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p

ggsave("plots/volcano_plot.png", width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 500)

```
